metadata.name: cHi-C_fastqToCool_hicup_c (release v0.3)
annotations: This workflow take as input a collection of paired fastq. It uses HiCUP to go from fastq to validPair file. The pairs are filtered for MAPQ and for the region captured. Then, they are sorted by cooler to generate a tabix dataset. Cooler is used to generate a balanced cool file to the desired resolution.
